question.text: In <math><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">R</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></msup></math>, consider the planes <math><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">P</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>1</mn></mrow></msub><mi mathvariant="normal"> </mi><mo>:</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">y</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></math> and <math><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">P</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub><mi mathvariant="normal"> </mi><mo>:</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">x</mi><mo>+</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">z</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>.</mo></math> Let <math><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">P</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></msub></math>, be a plane, different from <math><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">P</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>1</mn></mrow></msub></math> and <math><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">P</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub></math>, which passes through the intersection of <math><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">P</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>1</mn></mrow></msub></math> and <math><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">P</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub></math>. If the distance of the point <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfenced><mrow><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo><mo> </mo><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo><mo> </mo><mn>0</mn></mrow></mfenced></math>, from <math><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">P</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></msub></math>, is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>1</mn></math>, and the distance of a point <math><mo>(</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">α</mi><mo>,</mo><mi mathvariant="normal"> </mi><mi mathvariant="normal">β</mi><mo>,</mo><mi mathvariant="normal"> </mi><mi mathvariant="normal">γ</mi><mo>)</mo></math>, from <math><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">P</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></msub></math>, is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>2</mn></math>, then which of the following relations is (are) true ?

solution.text:
P1:y=0

P2:x+z=1

P3:y+λx+z-1=0



∴β+λα+γ-11+2λ2=±2

∴β+λα+γ-1=±21+2λ2


1-λ1+2λ2=±1
λ=-2   λ≠0

∴β-2α+γ-1=±23

2α-β+2γ+4=0 or 2α-β+2γ-8=0.
